body: Signal from Greg (2026-11-20 17:22Z, his direct word to Legal::Fable, relayed by Opus2 #6973), verbatim: „jedz teraz, bo ta synchronizacja nie ma sensu / oni za duza chca”. He told Legal to run its Central slot immediately instead of waiting behind the TermAl/Engram sequencing, finding our cross-project slot synchronization excessive. Lesson for coordinators: keep Central sequencing minimal. Don't hold other projects behind multi-step chains, avoid back-and-forth that crosses (the restart timing crossed three times that afternoon), and prefer simple rules over negotiated sequences.
